meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将混乱代码改造成清晰结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 代码越来越乱,想在不改功能的前提下变得清晰好维护。
copy.tagline_en: Restructure messy code into a clear, maintainable design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase is messy and you want to clean it up without changing behavior.

howto.what: 用户请它重构或整理代码时，它会先确认目标，再梳理相关文件、依赖与测试，制定分步计划；随后一步步修改，每步后运行检查避免出错，最后整套验证并汇总改动。
howto.when: 当用户提出重构、简化或提取等代码操作请求时触发。

say.text: 把 auth 模块里的校验逻辑抽到独立文件，并同步更新所有调用处。
say.note: 它先查引用和依赖，再动手改。

say.text: 把 AuthService 拆成几个小类，对外接口保持兼容。
say.note: 它评估影响范围后按计划重构。

say.text: 把整个项目里过时的 API 调用改成新写法。
say.note: 它先梳理全部调用点，再逐处修改并验证。

howto.what_en: Claude confirms the goal, analyzes related files/dependencies and tests, then plans stepwise. After each edit it runs checks, then full verification, and summarizes all changes.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks Claude to refactor, simplify, or extract code.

say_en.text: Extract auth module's validation logic into its own file and update usages.
say_en.note: It maps references/dependencies first, then edits.

say_en.text: Break AuthService into smaller classes, keeping behavior compatible.
say_en.note: It assesses impact and works through a plan.

say_en.text: Modernize all deprecated API calls in the project.
say_en.note: It finds every call site first, then changes and verifies.
